from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit import ParameterVector

n = params.get("n_qubits", 4)
theta = ParameterVector("t", 2 * n)
qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
for q in range(n):
    qc.ry(theta[q], q)
for q in range(n - 1):
    qc.cz(q, q + 1)
for q in range(n):
    qc.ry(theta[n + q], q)
